evidence_anchor.locator: stage4_revision_round1.tex, block B0087 (Reproducibility and Prospective Execution Interface / What is reproducible now)
evidence_anchor.quote: The version is Git commit \texttt{337994b72bd14c7ffbc1f01a6a9b878784df7694}; access requires read permission to that repository and checkout of that commit.

items.change_summary: Relative to the original single manifest identifier and hash, revised block B0087 adds a commit-pinned repository locator, a shared access condition, and exact paths and SHA-256 values for a substantial list of frozen artifacts.
items.residual_gap: The manifest is not exhaustive for artifacts still named by the revised manuscript: block B0045 names notes/stage1_phase2_annotated_bibliography.md without a SHA-256 value, and blocks B0087, B0107, B0123, and B0125 identify or rely on the closed bibliography and broader artifact categories without supplying a complete entry for each with locator, exact path, version, SHA-256, and access condition or an explicit unavailable designation.

evidence_anchor.locator: stage4_revision_round1.tex, block B0061 (Review-Adjudicated Proof and Method Architecture / Independent validator contract)
evidence_anchor.quote: At present \texttt{BP}, \texttt{CP}, both adapters, the checker, and an independently authored oracle are \texttt{UNAVAILABLE\_COMPONENT\_NOT\_IMPLEMENTED}; consequently no build hash is invented and validator independence is not established.

items.change_summary: Relative to the original generic checker description, revised block B0061 adds a typed trust graph, dependency classifications, a producer-decision-code exclusion, accountable-implementer fields, and explicit current unavailability.
items.residual_gap: No frozen fixture set with independently authored expected outcomes and recorded oracle provenance exists, and no producer, adapter, or checker build/provenance hashes are actually recorded; the manuscript explicitly marks those components and the oracle unavailable and the hashes prospective.

evidence_anchor.locator: stage4_revision_round1.tex, block B0057 (One common semantic owner-certificate schema / canonical bytes and compatibility)
evidence_anchor.quote: Canonical records use UTF-8 in NFC form, no byte-order mark, LF line endings, byte-lexicographically ordered object keys, prescribed array order, and no insignificant whitespace.

items.change_summary: Relative to the original prospective prose, revised blocks B0057 and B0059 add concrete canonical-byte, digest-domain, closed-field/enum, proof-registry, state-transition, and predicate/incompatibility rules, while B0128 adds synthetic prose traces.
items.residual_gap: The criterion requires concrete fixture bytes exercising at least one valid and one invalid record, but block B0062 still states that no fixture bytes or runs exist and block B0128 expressly labels its additions manuscript-local traces rather than executable fixture files; the predicate descriptions also remain prose rather than byte-replay fixtures.

evidence_anchor.locator: stage4_revision_round1.tex, block B0051 (Two surface-specific exact proof-producer contracts / Surface-specific population-completeness procedure)
evidence_anchor.quote: CP terminates only when the FIFO queue is empty and every outgoing edge from every included state has an included or rejected disposition.

items.change_summary: Relative to the original two high-level prospective producer paragraphs, revised block B0051 fixes hashed inputs, a CP enumeration domain and order, exact cutoff comparison, stopping conditions, stream accounting, an unresolved ledger, and checker replay obligations.
items.residual_gap: The BP contract does not state a deterministic enumeration order or an explicit canonical empty-stream order after replay, and the text does not assign each producer its own concrete coverage digest and exact termination measure; the two upstream stream hashes are not identified as per-producer coverage digests and the stated stop conditions do not supply every required measure.

evidence_anchor.locator: stage4_revision_round1.tex, block B0057 (One common semantic owner-certificate schema / compatibility and migration policy)
evidence_anchor.quote: Compatibility requires exact equality of both \texttt{schema\_version} and \texttt{proof\_registry\_digest}. items.change_summary: Relative to the original future-freeze statement, revised block B0057 makes schema-and-registry digest equality the default and gives every migration an independent version/digest plus full transformed-output revalidation.
